Run 5 episodes per candidate task type (2-way: internal + deterministic only) to identify which tasks show det > internal signal. Screen ~20 ScienceWorld task types, keep those with positive effect direction. ~30min per task type, ~10h total for 20 types on dual GPU.\\n\", \"priority\": \"P0\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 10, \"deps\": [], \"notes\": \"Reviewer W3: avoid wasting GPU on no-signal tasks like grow-plant. MVP task types (boil, melt, change-state, mix-paint) auto-pass. grow-plant confirmed no-signal (control). Target: identify 10-15 task types with signal.\\n\", \"status\": \"planned\"}, {\"id\": \"plan-001b\", \"claim\": [\"C1\", \"C2\"], \"description\": \"Episode-level counterfactual trajectory collection (Plan C) on signal-positive task types from plan-001a. For each task type, run 20 episodes under always-internal and 20 episodes under always-deterministic (separate full episodes, not per-step forking). Label ALL steps of the winning episode's modality: if det episode scores higher, all steps get label \\\"deterministic\\\"; if internal episode scores higher, all steps get label \\\"internal\\\". Death episodes (-100) automatically lose. Output: (observation, action, modality_label) triples for router SFT.\\n\", \"priority\": \"P0\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 20, \"deps\": [\"plan-001a\"], \"notes\": \"D010: Adopted Plan C after 1-step tie rate = 98.2% (D008) and fork-based approaches too expensive (73% action divergence → ~78h for K=20). Episode-level labeling aligns with safety-aware framing: router learns \\\"which episodes would die under internal reasoning\\\" rather than per-step deltas. plan-001a pre-screening data reusable if step-level observations were saved (Agent verifying). GPU savings: ~20h vs original 25h (no forking overhead). 2-way only (internal + deterministic) per Reviewer W2. vLLM backend on both GPUs for speed.\\n\", \"status\": \"planned\"}, {\"id\": \"plan-002\", \"claim\": \"C2\", \"description\": \"Router SFT training. Fine-tune Qwen3-1.7B on counterfactual labels from plan-001b. Cross-entropy loss, (history, observation) → {internal, deterministic}. Train/val split by task type (leave-one-out or 80/20).\\n\", \"priority\": \"P0\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 8, \"deps\": [\"plan-001b\"], \"notes\": \"Follow ARES training pipeline. Single GPU sufficient. Hyperparams: lr=2e-5, batch=32, epochs=3, max_seq_len=2048. 2-way classification (not 3-way) per W2 decision.\\n\", \"status\": \"planned\"}, {\"id\": \"plan-003\", \"claim\": \"C1\", \"description\": \"SimGate end-to-end evaluation on ScienceWorld. Run trained router + Qwen2.5-7B backbone on held-out episodes. Compare against: always-internal, always-deterministic, oracle-routing, random-routing, confidence-threshold heuristic. Report: continuous score (CogRouter protocol), success rate, catastrophic failure rate, simulator invocation ratio, total LLM tokens. KEY: This confirms/denies C1's \\\"selective > unconditional\\\" sub-claim (Reviewer W1).\\n\", \"priority\": \"P0\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 15, \"deps\": [\"plan-002\"], \"notes\": \"CogRouter (84.6) and ITP-R (62.58) cited from papers, not reproduced. Bootstrap 90% CI on all comparisons. Per-task-type breakdown. If trained router ≤ always-det, C1 downgrades per paper_framing.md note.\\n\", \"status\": \"planned\"}, {\"id\": \"plan-004\", \"claim\": \"C2\", \"description\": \"Explicit vs implicit routing ablation (parameter-controlled). Three conditions: (a) 1.7B explicit router (SimGate) — Qwen3-1.7B, separate module (b) 1.7B implicit router — Qwen3-1.7B SFT'd to output [SIMULATE] token inline (c) 7B implicit routing — Qwen2.5-7B backbone decides via tool-use prompt All trained on same counterfactual data from plan-001b. Condition (b) is the parameter-matched control (Reviewer W4).\\n\", \"priority\": \"P0\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 12, \"deps\": [\"plan-001b\"], \"notes\": \"Reviewer W4: 7B implicit vs 1.7B explicit confounds architecture with capacity. Adding 1.7B implicit isolates explicit vs implicit architectural effect. Can run in parallel with plan-002 on second GPU.\\n\", \"status\": \"planned\"}, {\"id\": \"plan-005\", \"claim\": [\"C1\", \"C2\"], \"description\": \"Per-task routing pattern analysis. From plan-003 outputs, analyze: (a) which task categories trigger deterministic routing most, (b) at which episode phases (early/mid/late) routing decisions concentrate, (c) router-as-diagnostic-probe — cluster deterministic-routing steps to identify systematic LLM failure modes (e.g., multi-step physical reasoning failures). Output: routing heatmap figure + failure mode taxonomy.\\n\", \"priority\": \"P0\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 2, \"deps\": [\"plan-003\"], \"notes\": \"Analysis-only, minimal GPU. Main output is Figure 1 for the paper.\", \"status\": \"planned\"}, {\"id\": \"plan-006\", \"claim\": \"C2\", \"description\": \"2-way vs 3-way routing ablation. Supplement plan-001b data with deep-internal modality on subset of tasks. Compare {internal, deterministic} vs {fast-internal, deep-internal, deterministic}. Tests whether the fast/deep internal distinction adds value beyond binary routing.\\n\", \"priority\": \"P1\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 10, \"deps\": [\"plan-002\"], \"notes\": \"If 3-way > 2-way, retrain router as 3-way and update paper. If 2-way ≈ 3-way, simplifies the story (binary routing suffices). Requires supplemental trajectory data for deep-internal (~5h additional collection).\\n\", \"status\": \"planned\"}, {\"id\": \"plan-007\", \"claim\": \"C1\", \"description\": \"Boil task rerun with v3 code. MVP boil data used old code (>= tie-break, death filter on all 3 modes). Rerun with clean v3 code for unified analysis.\\n\", \"priority\": \"P1\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 3, \"deps\": [], \"notes\": \"Can run in parallel with plan-001a as first batch.\", \"status\": \"planned\"}, {\"id\": \"plan-008\", \"claim\": \"C2\", \"description\": \"Router size ablation. Compare Qwen3-1.7B vs Qwen2.5-1.5B vs Qwen2.5-3B as router. Tests sensitivity to router capacity.\\n\", \"priority\": \"P1\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 12, \"deps\": [\"plan-001b\"], \"notes\": \"Important for \\\"lightweight\\\" claim. If 1.5B matches 1.7B, strengthens \\\"small router suffices\\\". Low priority relative to core experiments.\\n\", \"status\": \"planned\"}, {\"id\": \"plan-011\", \"claim\": \"C1\", \"description\": \"Rule-based routing baseline (Dream all tiers). Keyword-matching heuristic: route actions containing state-change keywords (heat, cool, boil, melt, freeze, mix, react, pour, activate) to simulator, everything else to internal reasoning. Compares against learned router to demonstrate non-trivial learned signal.\\n\", \"priority\": \"P0\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 2, \"deps\": [\"plan-001b\"], \"notes\": \"Dream median + worst flagged this as missing. Critical for defending \\\"the router learns beyond action-type keywords.\\\" Cheap — just inference, no training. PRE-REGISTERED keyword list at src/rule_based_keywords.json. Do NOT modify after experiment starts.\\n\", \"status\": \"planned\"}, {\"id\": \"plan-012\", \"claim\": \"C1\", \"description\": \"Death-decomposition analysis (Dream all tiers). From plan-003 outputs, separately report: (a) gains on death-risk episodes only (episodes where always-internal scores -100) (b) gains on non-death episodes only (c) fraction of routing labels from genuine score differences vs tie-break artifacts (d) correlation between per-task death rate and SimGate gain (r value)\\n\", \"priority\": \"P0\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 0, \"deps\": [\"plan-003\"], \"notes\": \"Analysis-only, no GPU. Essential for \\\"safety-aware\\\" framing — must quantify what proportion of gain comes from death avoidance vs positive guidance. All 3 Dream tiers flagged ScienceWorld penalty structure as concern. Additional (Reviewer): report scores with -100 penalty replaced by 0 (penalty-removed variant) to directly answer \\\"how much does the penalty structure inflate gains?\\\"\\n\", \"status\": \"planned\"}, {\"id\": \"plan-013\", \"claim\": [\"C1\", \"C2\"], \"description\": \"Labeling quality analysis (Dream best + worst). From plan-001b trajectory data, characterize: (a) fraction of steps where all modalities give identical score (tie rate) (b) fraction of \\\"deterministic-preferred\\\" labels from genuine score difference vs tie-break (c) sensitivity: retrain router on strict-only labels (excluding ties), compare performance\\n\", \"priority\": \"P1\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 4, \"deps\": [\"plan-001b\"], \"notes\": \"Addresses oracle circularity concern from worst case Dream. If strict-only labels produce similar router, tie-break is harmless. If dramatically different, must discuss.\\n\", \"status\": \"planned\"}, {\"id\": \"plan-009\", \"claim\": \"C1\", \"description\": \"MATH track — code interpreter as deterministic oracle. 500 Level 4-5 MATH problems. 2-way routing: internal / code-interpreter. Demonstrates generalization beyond environment simulators.\\n\", \"priority\": \"P2\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 20, \"deps\": [\"plan-002\"], \"notes\": \"Human Review Note suggested MATH as secondary track. Only if ScienceWorld experiments finish by Day 8.\\n\", \"status\": \"planned\"}, {\"id\": \"plan-010\", \"claim\": \"C2\", \"description\": \"Cross-task transfer within ScienceWorld. Train router on chemistry tasks only, evaluate on physics tasks (and vice versa). Tests whether routing patterns transfer across task domains.\\n\", \"priority\": \"P2\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 5, \"deps\": [\"plan-002\"], \"status\": \"planned\"}], \"total\": 14}, \"error\": null, \"metadata\": {}}"}

(2026-05-13)\\n\\n### Verdict: PASS (4/5 tasks 显著正向)\\n\\nPhase 1 验证了 fork-based deterministic evaluation 在 ScienceWorld 上显著优于纯 LLM 内部推理。\\n\\n### 关键设计决策与教训\\n\\n1. **Tie-break 策略**: `>` (strict) 而非 `>=`。95%+ 步骤 score_delta=0（稀疏奖励），`>=` 会让 oracle 退化为 always-internal。\\n\\n2. **Death filter 只用于有 fork 的模式**: always-internal 是纯 LLM baseline，不能调 fork/is_lethal。\\n\\n3. **melt 与 change-state internal 分数巧合相同**: 共享 environment variations，不是数据重复。\\n\\n4. **vLLM 兼容性**: torch 2.10.0 + vLLM 0.18.1 需注释 select_algorithm.py 1695/2164 行。\\n\\n5. **phase1_signal.py 不支持 --seed 参数**。\\n\\n### 竞品对标\\n- CogRouter (arXiv 2602.12662): Qwen2.5-7B, Score=84.6, SR=72.0%。路由 thinking depth（4 levels）。\\n- ITP-R (arXiv 2601.08955): Learned WM + K-head gating, SR=63.91%。WM 有 compounding error。\\n\\n## ⚠️ 核心发现：Det 优势几乎完全来自死亡回避 (2026-05-13)\\n\\n### Death rate 分析\\n\\n| 数据集 | I_death | D_death | Δ(D-I) | Δ_no_death |\\n|--------|---------|---------|--------|------------|\\n| Prescreening (8 tasks) | 48.6% | 5.4% | +43.9 | **-4.5** |\\n| MVP (5 tasks) | 41.0% | 12.0% | +29.2 | **-0.4** |\\n\\n**排除死亡 episode 后 det 反而略差于 internal。** Det 全部优势来自 death filter 阻止致命动作（\\\"focus on 错误对象\\\" → -100），不是推理质量更好。\\n\\n### 对 Paper Framing 的影响\\n- 原 framing \\\"det improves agent performance\\\" 需调整\\n- 实际机制：fork-based safety gate（检测并阻止致命动作）\\n- 更可防御的 claim：\\\"selective routing prevents catastrophic failures\\\"\\n- Router 应学到\\\"有风险时走 det，安全时走 internal\\\"\\n\\n### SFT 数据 class imbalance\\n- MVP 3 tasks 后处理：750 SFT triples，全标 \\\"deterministic\\\"（0 个 internal wins）\\n- 原因：包含 death 的 episode det 必赢；no-death episode 多为 tie\\n- 需要 step-level death risk features 而非 episode-level labels\\n\\n## Labeling 策略演进 (2026-05-13)\\n\\n### 1-step labeling → 不可行（tie rate 98.2%）\\n### Episode-terminal (K=10) → Director 取消（成本太高，78h 双卡）\\n### Plan C (episode-level) → 当前方案，但 class imbalance 严重\\n### Action divergence rate: 73.1%（几乎每步都不同，但 1-step score 无差异）\\n\\n## D011 关键发现：Det 优势 = 纯 Death Avoidance (2026-05-13)\\n\\nMVP 5 个 task 全部 death-dominated（修正后 grow-plant 为 no-effect）。非 death 情况下 Δ(D-I) 为负（-0.4 到 -4.5），det 不提供 general reasoning improvement。\\n\\n**结论：router 的核心价值是 death-risk detection，不是 general reasoning improvement。**\\n\\n## D011 关键发现：1-step Labeling 失败 (D008, 2026-05-13)\\n\\n- 98.2% tie rate 使 per-step 标注无效\\n- Action divergence rate 73.1% 但 1-step score delta = 0（动作不同但即时分数无差异）\\n- 决策：采用 episode-level labeling（Plan C）\\n\\n## Labeling 策略完整演进路径 (2026-05-13)\\n\\n1. **1-step labeling** → 失败（98.2% tie，稀疏奖励下无区分度）\\n2. **Episode-terminal K=10** → 取消（78h 双卡，成本过高）\\n3. **Plan C episode-level** → 已采用\\n4. **Plan C + death-aware labeling** = 最终方案\\n\\n## Class Imbalance 风险与解法 (2026-05-13)\\n\\n- MVP SFT 数据 750/750 全标 deterministic（0 internal wins）\\n- 根因：death episodes 使 det 自动赢，non-death episodes 大部分 tie\\n- 解法：death-aware labeling + 混合 task 选择（确保 internal ≥ 15%）\\n\\n## Signal Type 分类框架 (2026-05-13)\\n\\n| 类型 | 定义 | 论文价值 {"success": true, "data": {"path": "/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_12/projects/simgate-modular-routing/memory.md", "content": "## Phase 1 MVP 最终结论 (2026-05-13)

### Verdict: PASS (4/5 tasks 显著正向)

Phase 1 验证了 fork-based deterministic evaluation 在 ScienceWorld 上显著优于纯 LLM 内部推理。

### 关键设计决策与教训

1. **Tie-break 策略**: `>` (strict) 而非 `>=`。95%+ 步骤 score_delta=0（稀疏奖励），`>=` 会让 oracle 退化为 always-internal。

2. **Death filter 只用于有 fork 的模式**: always-internal 是纯 LLM baseline，不能调 fork/is_lethal。

3. **melt 与 change-state internal 分数巧合相同**: 共享 environment variations，不是数据重复。

4. **vLLM 兼容性**: torch 2.10.0 + vLLM 0.18.1 需注释 select_algorithm.py 1695/2164 行。

5. **phase1_signal.py 不支持 --seed 参数**。

### 竞品对标
- CogRouter (arXiv 2602.12662): Qwen2.5-7B, Score=84.6, SR=72.0%。路由 thinking depth（4 levels）。
- ITP-R (arXiv 2601.08955): Learned WM + K-head gating, SR=63.91%。WM 有 compounding error。

## ⚠️ 核心发现：Det 优势几乎完全来自死亡回避 (2026-05-13)

### Death rate 分析

| 数据集 | I_death | D_death | Δ(D-I) | Δ_no_death |
|--------|---------|---------|--------|------------|
| Prescreening (8 tasks) | 48.6% | 5.4% | +43.9 | **-4.5** |
| MVP (5 tasks) | 41.0% | 12.0% | +29.2 | **-0.4** |

**排除死亡 episode 后 det 反而略差于 internal。** Det 全部优势来自 death filter 阻止致命动作（"focus on 错误对象" → -100），不是推理质量更好。

### 对 Paper Framing 的影响
- 原 framing "det improves agent performance" 需调整
- 实际机制：fork-based safety gate（检测并阻止致命动作）
- 更可防御的 claim："selective routing prevents catastrophic failures"
- Router 应学到"有风险时走 det，安全时走 internal"

### SFT 数据 class imbalance
- MVP 3 tasks 后处理：750 SFT triples，全标 "deterministic"（0 个 internal wins）
- 原因：包含 death 的 episode det 必赢；no-death episode 多为 tie
- 需要 step-level death risk features 而非 episode-level labels

## Labeling 策略演进 (2026-05-13)

### 1-step labeling → 不可行（tie rate 98.2%）
### Episode-terminal (K=10) → Director 取消（成本太高，78h 双卡）
### Plan C (episode-level) → 当前方案，但 class imbalance 严重
### Action divergence rate: 73.1%（几乎每步都不同，但 1-step score 无差异）

## D011 关键发现：Det 优势 = 纯 Death Avoidance (2026-05-13)

MVP 5 个 task 全部 death-dominated（修正后 grow-plant 为 no-effect）。非 death 情况下 Δ(D-I) 为负（-0.4 到 -4.5），det 不提供 general reasoning improvement。

**结论：router 的核心价值是 death-risk detection，不是 general reasoning improvement。**

## D011 关键发现：1-step Labeling 失败 (D008, 2026-05-13)

- 98.2% tie rate 使 per-step 标注无效
- Action divergence rate 73.1% 但 1-step score delta = 0（动作不同但即时分数无差异）
- 决策：采用 episode-level labeling（Plan C）

## Labeling 策略完整演进路径 (2026-05-13)

1. **1-step labeling** → 失败（98.2% tie，稀疏奖励下无区分度）
2. **Episode-terminal K=10** → 取消（78h 双卡，成本过高）
3. **Plan C episode-level** → 已采用
4. **Plan C + death-aware labeling** = 最终方案

## Class Imbalance 风险与解法 (2026-05-13)

- MVP SFT 数据 750/750 全标 deterministic（0 internal wins）
- 根因：death episodes 使 det 自动赢，non-death episodes 大部分 tie
- 解法：death-aware labeling + 混合 task 选择（确保 internal ≥ 15%）

## Signal Type 分类框架 (2026-05-13)

| 类型 | 定义 | 论文价值 |
|------|------|----------|
| death-dominated | det 优势完全来自 death avoidance | 证明 safety gate 有效 |
| genuine-det | 非 death 情况下 det 仍优于 internal | **最有价值**：证明 router 不仅做 death detection |
| internal-preferred | internal 优于 det | 证明需要 routing 而非 always-det |
| no-effect | 两种模式无差异 | 排除噪声 task |
| mixed | 混合信号 | 需进一步分析 |

genuine-det 类型对论文至关重要：证明 router 的价值不局限于 death detection，而是能识别 deterministic reasoning genuinely helps 的场景。", "total_chars": 3176, "truncated": false}, "error": null, "metadata": {}}

# Finetunes Qwen3-1.7B (or fallback) on episode-level labeled data
# from Plan C (labeled_steps.jsonl) for 2-way classification: internal vs deterministic.
#
# Data dependency: results/plan_c/{task_type}/labeled_steps.jsonl
# Usage: python src/router_sft_train.py --help

import argparse
import json
import os
import glob
import random
import warnings
from collections import Counter
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional, Tuple

import numpy as np
import torch
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader, WeightedRandomSampler
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, precision_recall_fscore_support, confusion_matrix
from transformers import (
    AutoTokenizer,
    AutoModelForSequenceClassification,
    TrainingArguments,
    Trainer,
    EarlyStoppingCallback,
)
from peft import LoraConfig, get_peft_model, TaskType

LABEL2ID = {"internal": 0, "deterministic": 1}
ID2LABEL = {0: "internal", 1: "deterministic"}

SYSTEM_PROMPT = (
    "You are a routing classifier. Given the current observation and action history, "
    "predict which reasoning modality will lead to a better outcome."
)

    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Router SFT: finetune LLM for 2-way routing classification")
    p.add_argument("--data_dir", type=str, default="results/plan_c/",
                    help="Directory containing {task_type}/labeled_steps.jsonl")
    p.add_argument("--model_name", type=str, default="Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B",
                    help="HuggingFace model name or local path")
    p.add_argument("--output_dir", type=str, default="results/router_sft/",
                    help="Output directory for checkpoints and reports")
    p.add_argument("--epochs", type=int, default=3)
    p.add_argument("--batch_size", type=int, default=16)
    p.add_argument("--eval_batch_size", type=int, default=32)
    p.add_argument("--lr", type=float, default=2e-4)
    p.add_argument("--lora_r", type=int, default=16)
    p.add_argument("--lora_alpha", type=int, default=32)

{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "# Plan C episode-level labeling data collection for router SFT training.
#
# For each task variation, runs 2 complete episodes (always-internal + always-deterministic),
# compares final episode scores to label each step's modality preference.
# Reuses run_episode_internal / run_episode_deterministic from signal_prescreening.py.
#
# Outputs:
#   {output_dir}/{task_type}/labeled_steps.jsonl  — one labeled step per line (training data)
#   {output_dir}/{task_type}/episode_summary.jsonl — one episode summary per line
#
# Usage:
#   python src/episode_level_collection.py --task_types "boil,melt" --episodes 20 --gpu_id 0

import argparse
import json
import os
import random
import sys
import time
from typing import List, Dict, Any

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from scienceworld_utils import (
    create_env, reset_env, get_valid_actions, get_score,
    step_env, close_env, fork_and_lookahead, get_task_types,
    get_max_variations,
)
from llm_agent import LLMAgent, find_model_path

DEATH_THRESHOLD = -100


def resolve_task_type(name: str) -> str:
    try:
        available = get_task_types()
    except Exception:
        return name
    if name in available:
        return name
    matches = [t for t in available if name.lower() in t.lower()]
    if matches:
        return matches[0]
    return name


def is_lethal(fr: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    if fr["done"] and fr["score"] < 0:
        return True
    if fr["score"] <= -100:
        return True
    return False


def run_episode_internal(
    agent: LLMAgent,
    task_name: str,
    variation_idx: int,
    max_steps: int,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Always-internal: pure LLM ReAct, no death filter."""
    env = create_env(task_name, variation_idx)
    obs, _ = reset_env(env)
    initial_score = get_score(env)

    steps = []
    action_history = []
    history_dicts = []
    t0 = time.time()

    for step_idx in range(max_steps):
        valid_actions = get_valid_actions(env)
        if not valid_actions:
            break

        action, raw_output = agent.select_action_react(obs, valid_actions, history_dicts)

        score_before = get_score(env)
        obs_new, reward, done, info = step_env(env, action)
        score_after = get_score(env)

        steps.append({
            "step": step_idx,
            "action": action,
            "modality": "internal",
            "score_before": score_before,
            "score_after": score_after,
            "score_delta": score_after - score_before,
            "observation": obs_new[:500],
            "llm_output": raw_output[:300],
            "action_history": list(action_history),
            "is_dead": score_after <= DEATH_THRESHOLD,
        })
        action_history.append(action)
        history_dicts.append({"action": action, "observation": obs_new[:200], "score": score_after})
        obs = obs_new

        if done:
            break

    final_score = get_score(env)
    close_env(env)

    return {
        "mode": "always-internal",
        "task_name": task_name,
        "variation_idx": variation_idx,
        "final_score": final_score,
        "initial_score": initial_score,
        "num_steps": len(steps),
        "total_time_s": time.time() - t0,
        "steps": steps,
        "action_history": action_history,
    }


def run_episode_deterministic(
    agent: LLMAgent,
    task_name: str,
    variation_idx: int,
    max_steps: int,
    n_candidates: int = 3,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Always-deterministic: LLM candidates + fork evaluation + death filter."""
    env = create_env(task_name, variation_idx)
    obs, _ = reset_env(env)
    initial_score = get_score(env)

    steps = []
    action_history = []
    history_dicts = []
    t0 = time.time()

    for step_idx in range(max_steps):
        valid_actions = get_valid_actions(env)
        if not valid_actions:
            break

        candidates, raw_output = agent.generate_candidate_actions(
            obs, valid_actions, history_dicts, n=n_candidates
        )

        best_action = None
        best_delta = float("-inf")
        best_action_fallback = None
        best_delta_fallback = float("-inf")
        fork_results = []
        for cand in candidates:
            fr = fork_and_lookahead(task_name, variation_idx, action_history, cand)
            lethal = is_lethal(fr)
            fork_results.append({
                "action": cand,
                "score_delta": fr["score_delta"],
                "score": fr["score"],
                "lethal": lethal,
            })
            if fr["score_delta"] > best_delta_fallback:
                best_delta_fallback = fr["score_delta"]
                best_action_fallback = cand
            if not lethal and fr["score_delta"] > best_delta:
                best_delta = fr["score_delta"]
                best_action = cand

        if best_action is None:
            best_action = best_action_fallback if best_action_fallback else valid_actions[0]

        score_before = get_score(env)
        obs_new, reward, done, info = step_env(env, best_action)
        score_after = get_score(env)

        steps.append({
            "step": step_idx,
            "action": best_action,
            "modality": "deterministic",
            "score_before": score_before,
            "score_after": score_after,
            "score_delta": score_after - score_before,
            "candidates": fork_results,
            "observation": obs_new[:500],
            "llm_output": raw_output[:300],
            "action_history": list(action_history),
            "is_dead": score_after <= DEATH_THRESHOLD,
        })
        action_history.append(best_action)
        history_dicts.append({"action": best_action, "observation": obs_new[:200], "score": score_after})
        obs = obs_new

        if done:
            break

    final_score = get_score(env)
    close_env(env)

    return {
        "mode": "always-deterministic",
        "task_name": task_name,
        "variation_idx": variation_idx,
        "final_score": final_score,
        "initial_score": initial_score,
        "num_steps": len(steps),
        "total_time_s": time.time() - t0,
        "steps": steps,
        "action_history": action_history,
    }


def label_episode(internal_final: float, det_final: float) -> str:
    internal_death = internal_final <= DEATH_THRESHOLD
    det_death = det_final <= DEATH_THRESHOLD

    if internal_death and det_death:
        return "tie"
    if internal_death:
        return "deterministic"
    if det_death:
        return "internal"

    if det_final > internal_final:
        return "deterministic"
    elif internal_final > det_final:
        return "internal"
    else:
        return "tie"


def run_task_collection(
    agent: LLMAgent,
    task_name: str,
    n_episodes: int,
    start_episode: int,
    max_steps: int,
    output_dir: str,
    n_candidates: int = 3,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    task_dir = os.path.join(output_dir, task_name.replace(" ", "_"))
    os.makedirs(task_dir, exist_ok=True)

    steps_file = os.path.join(task_dir, "labeled_steps.jsonl")
    summary_file = os.path.join(task_dir, "episode_summary.jsonl")

    max_var = get_max_variations(task_name)
    end_episode = start_episode + n_episodes

import json
import os
from collections import defaultdict

RESULTS_DIR = "/root/autodl-tmp/simgate-modular-routing/results/mvp"
OUTPUT_DIR = "/root/autodl-tmp/simgate-modular-routing/results/sft_data"
TASKS = ["melt", "change-the-state-of-matter-of", "chemistry-mix-paint-secondary-color"]
DEATH_SCORE = -100.0


def load_episodes(task_name):
    path = os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, task_name, "episodes.jsonl")
    episodes = []
    with open(path) as f:
        for line in f:
            episodes.append(json.loads(line))
    return episodes


def determine_winner(internal_score, det_score):
    internal_dead = internal_score == DEATH_SCORE
    det_dead = det_score == DEATH_SCORE

    if internal_dead and det_dead:
        return "tie"
    if internal_dead:
        return "deterministic"
    if det_dead:
        return "internal"

    if det_score > internal_score:
        return "deterministic"
    elif internal_score > det_score:
        return "internal"
    else:
        return "tie"


def extract_steps(run_data):
    steps = []
    for s in run_data["steps"]:
        steps.append({
            "step": s["step"],
            "observation": s["observation"],
            "action": s["action"],
        })
    return steps


def main():
    os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

    all_triples = []
    summary = {
        "total_episodes_paired": 0,
        "total_steps": 0,
        "tie_count": 0,
        "det_wins": 0,
        "internal_wins": 0,
        "per_task": {},
    }

    for task in TASKS:
        episodes = load_episodes(task)
        task_stats = {
            "episodes_paired": 0,
            "steps": 0,
            "tie_count": 0,
            "det_wins": 0,
            "internal_wins": 0,
            "variations": {},
        }

        for ep in episodes:
            var_idx = ep["variation_idx"]
            internal_data = ep["always_internal"]
            det_data = ep["always_deterministic"]
            internal_score = internal_data["final_score"]
            det_score = det_data["final_score"]

            task_stats["episodes_paired"] += 1
            summary["total_episodes_paired"] += 1

            winner = determine_winner(internal_score, det_score)

            task_stats["variations"][var_idx] = {
                "internal_score": internal_score,
                "det_score": det_score,
                "winner": winner,
            }

            if winner == "tie":
                task_stats["tie_count"] += 1
                summary["tie_count"] += 1
                continue

            if winner == "deterministic":
                task_stats["det_wins"] += 1
                summary["det_wins"] += 1
                winning_data = det_data
            else:
                task_stats["internal_wins"] += 1
                summary["internal_wins"] += 1
                winning_data = internal_data

            steps = extract_steps(winning_data)
            for step_info in steps:
                triple = {
                    "task_type": task,
                    "variation": var_idx,
                    "step": step_info["step"],
                    "observation": step_info["observation"],
                    "action": step_info["action"],
                    "label": winner,
                }
                all_triples.append(triple)
                task_stats["steps"] += 1
                summary["total_steps"] += 1

        summary["per_task"][task] = task_stats

    out_path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "sft_triples.jsonl")
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        for t in all_triples:
            f.write(json.dumps(t, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    summary_path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "collection_summary.json")
    with open(summary_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(summary, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

    print(f"=== SFT Post-processing Complete ===")
    print(f"Total episodes paired: {summary['total_episodes_paired']}")
    print(f"  det wins:      {summary['det_wins']}")
    print(f"  internal wins: {summary['internal_wins']}")
    print(f"  ties (dropped):{summary['tie_count']}")
    print(f"Total SFT triples: {summary['total_steps']}")
    print()
    for task, ts in summary["per_task"].items():
        print(f"[{task}]")
        print(f"  paired={ts['episodes_paired']}, det={ts['det_wins']}, int={ts['internal_wins']}, tie={ts['tie_count']}, steps={ts['steps']}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import json
import os
import sys
from collections import defaultdict
from typing import Dict, List, Any, Tuple

DEATH_THRESHOLD = -100


def is_dead(final_score: float) -> bool:
    return final_score <= DEATH_THRESHOLD


def classify_episode(int_score: float, det_score: float) -> Tuple[str, str, str]:
    """Returns (label, reason, signal_source). Never discards."""
    int_died = is_dead(int_score)
    det_died = is_dead(det_score)

    if int_died and not det_died:
        return "det-preferred", "int_died_det_alive", "death_asymmetry"
    if det_died and not int_died:
        return "internal-preferred", "det_died_int_alive", "death_asymmetry"
    if int_died and det_died:
        return "no-preference", "both_died", "both_dead"
    if det_score > int_score:
        return "det-preferred", "both_alive_det_wins", "score_comparison"
    if int_score > det_score:
        return "internal-preferred", "both_alive_int_wins", "score_comparison"
    return "no-preference", "tie", "tied_alive"


def extract_steps(episode_data: Dict, label: str, reason: str,
                  signal_source: str,
                  task_type: str, episode_idx: int, variation_idx: int,
                  int_score: float, det_score: float,
                  int_died: bool, det_died: bool) -> List[Dict]:
    if label == "internal-preferred":
        source_key = "always_internal"
    elif label == "det-preferred":
        source_key = "always_deterministic"
    else:
        source_key = "always_internal"

    source_ep = episode_data[source_key]
    steps = source_ep.get("steps", [])
    action_history = []
    triples = []

    for s in steps:
        triples.append({
            "task_type": task_type,
            "episode_id": episode_idx,
            "variation": variation_idx,
            "step_idx": s["step"],
            "observation": s.get("observation", ""),
            "action": s["action"],
            "action_history": list(action_history),
            "label": label,
            "signal_source": signal_source,
            "labeling_reason": reason,
            "episode_score_internal": int_score,
            "episode_score_det": det_score,
            "internal_died": int_died,
            "det_died": det_died,
        })
        action_history.append(s["action"])

    return triples


def process_dir(input_dir: str) -> Tuple[List[Dict], Dict[str, int]]:
    task_type = os.path.basename(input_dir.rstrip("/"))
    episodes_path = os.path.join(input_dir, "episodes.jsonl")
    if not os.path.exists(episodes_path):
        print(f"  SKIP {task_type}: no episodes.jsonl")
        return [], {}

    stats = defaultdict(int)
    all_triples = []

    with open(episodes_path) as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            ep = json.loads(line)

            episode_idx = ep.get("episode_idx", stats["total_episodes"])
            variation_idx = ep.get("variation_idx", 0)

            if "always_internal" in ep and "always_deterministic" in ep:
                int_score = ep["always_internal"]["final_score"]
                det_score = ep["always_deterministic"]["final_score"]
            else:
                stats["total_episodes"] += 1
                stats["format_error"] += 1
                continue

            int_died = is_dead(int_score)
            det_died = is_dead(det_score)
            label, reason, signal_source = classify_episode(int_score, det_score)

            stats["total_episodes"] += 1
            reason_key_map = {
                "int_died_det_alive": "det_wins_death",
                "det_died_int_alive": "int_wins_death",
                "both_alive_det_wins": "det_wins_score",
                "both_alive_int_wins": "int_wins_score",
                "tie": "ties",
                "both_died": "both_died",
            }
            stats[reason_key_map[reason]] += 1

            triples = extract_steps(
                ep, label, reason, signal_source,
                task_type, episode_idx, variation_idx,
                int_score, det_score, int_died, det_died,
            )
            all_triples.extend(triples)

            if label == "det-preferred":
                stats["det_preferred_steps"] += len(triples)
            elif label == "internal-preferred":
                stats["int_preferred_steps"] += len(triples)
            else:
                stats["no_preference_steps"] += len(triples)

    return all_triples, dict(stats)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Death-aware 3-label labeling for SFT")
    parser.add_argument("--input_dirs", required=True, help="Comma-separated input directories")
    parser.add_argument("--output_dir", default="results/sft_data_death_aware/")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    input_dirs = [d.strip() for d in args.input_dirs.split(",")]
    os.makedirs(args.output_dir, exist_ok=True)

    all_triples = []
    per_task = {}
    totals = defaultdict(int)

    for d in input_dirs:
        triples, stats = process_dir(d)
        if not stats:

        task_type = os.path.basename(d.rstrip("/"))
